title: Non-Sperner Intervals and Exact Deficiency Family in the Permutation Pattern Poset
abstract: Unconditional Lean 4 + Mathlib formalization refuting McNamara and Steingrimsson's Question 9.5 (2015) via an explicit 19-element closed interval [213, 2574613] of largest rank size 7 and width 8, and proving that for every k >= 1 there exists a principal downset [empty, tau_k] whose width exceeds its largest rank size by exactly k. Companion write-up and dated prior-work searches (arXiv, CORE 2026-11-20, Google Scholar 2026-11-22, Zenodo, DataCite, HAL, OSF, and Elizalde-McNamara 2015 / Vatter 2026) are published at https://mathdiscoveries.org/results/pattern-poset-not-sperner; no prior non-Sperner interval of the classical pattern poset was found in those logged searches, while Pouzet-Rosenberg (1986), Burosch et al. (1990, 1996), and print monographs remain unread/unsearched.
